compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN (makes T1 tests pass)

## Story DD Coverage
DD1: streaming=False + fallbacks=[...] + context_window_fallbacks=[...]
DD2: hop rendered in PR summary
DD3: fallback_exhausted entry (atomic write)

## Implementation
Function: review_with_fallbacks(diff_text, agent_id, primary_model, provider_chain, config_path=None) -> dict

- Build fallbacks list: [{model: "openai/<model>"} for each non-primary provider in chain]
- Build context_window_fallbacks list: haiku→sonnet→opus on primary provider
- Call litellm.completion(model=primary_model, messages=[...], streaming=False, fallbacks=..., context_window_fallbacks=...)
- On success: return parsed JSON findings dict
- On litellm.exceptions.APIError (full chain exhausted): write fallback_exhausted entry (6 fields) atomically via temp+rename
- Hop rendering: parse litellm response metadata for successful fallbacks, render as [fallback: <agent> <primary> -> <fallback> (<exc>)]
- S3 integration note: runner.py and asyncio.gather dispatch are S3 scope; dispatch.py is a library

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh passes (all T1 tests GREEN)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] ruff check passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] dispatch.py importable
  Verify: PYTHONPATH=plugins/dso/scripts python3 -c "from dso_ci_review.dispatch import review_with_fallbacks"
- [ ] streaming=False verified in litellm calls (no streaming=True anywhere in dispatch.py)
  Verify: ! grep "streaming=True" plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/dispatch.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
